mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE below 4%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% does not produce positive 5d returns in >60% of instances (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing boom characterized by elevated new home construction (HOUST > 1800) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 650000) indicates robust demand that precedes positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1800 and RSAFS > 650000 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Lower unemployment rates (UNRATE) reflect a tight labor market that supports consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is low (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 5.5% (CPIAUCSL) triggers central bank tightening expectations, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 5.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (rising FEDFUNDS) combined with a weakening manufacturing sector (falling INDPRO) creates a stagflationary environment that depresses equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS rising and INDPRO falling does not produce negative 20d returns in >60% of instances (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100) signals reduced industrial activity and potential economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
